claim: An unrelated symlink directory outside every declared include is propagated as a coverage gap to all queries, invalidating otherwise unchanged independent facts.

evidence.summary: The root-wide traversal records every non-built-in-excluded directory symlink in the shared walk_gaps list before checking any query include or exclude.
Every shared traversal gap is appended to every query outcome, regardless of which declared scope could reach the path.
A query gap changes the captured observation and incomplete(current) marks the associated fact pending.
The existing contract preserves facts for unrelated changes, but this test only covers an ordinary out-of-scope file, not an unrelated symlink directory.

Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt python <evaluation>/convergence-review/reproduce_scope_gap.py from the repository. It captures independent src/**/*.py and config/**/*.py facts, adds unrelated-link -> src outside both scopes, and observes both facts become unknown with gap 'symlink directory not scanned: unrelated-link'. The capture CLI exits 0; refresh exits 1. Their source hashes are unchanged; deleting the link leaves both pending. Full JSON evidence is in scope-gap-evidence.json.

impact: Adding an unrelated directory symlink makes every query-backed fact unknown and creates persistent pending review even though no declared evidence or in-scope reference changed. The affected facts cannot be confirmed while the unrelated link exists, and removing it still leaves unnecessary review work.
